 Posted Nov 17, 2026 at 5:30 PM UTC J Youtube Jay Peters GTA VI’s voice actor for Lucia was revealed by… The Game Awards. Rockstar hasn’t publicly said who is playing the two leads in GTA VI , but The Game Awards’ nominee video says that Manni L. Perez has been nominated for Best Performance for her work in the game.
 GTA VI earned eight nominations , the most of any title, including one for Game of the Year .
